component.name: WideMelon
component.summary: Widescreen Nintendo DS emulator with a phone controller

description.p: WideMelon is a widescreen Nintendo DS emulator based on melonDS. It reveals more of supported 3D scenes while preserving native 2D proportions, and can use a phone as the bottom screen and touch controller.

ul.li: Adds a new home screen with the WideMelon logo and recent ROMs.
Adds quick access to display settings, phone pairing, and ROM selection.
Separates display settings from the phone connection dialog.
Keeps the new home screen visible above the OpenGL renderer while idle.
Fixes a Wayland crash when opening a recent ROM from the home screen.
